# Huntsman bow

Internal ID: BowHuntsman | Type: Bow | Source: Forge | Usage: Ranged weapon | Wielding: Two-handed | Crafting Materials: Finewood x15, Iron x30, Feathers x15, Deer hide x6 | Attack speed: 0.8 s + 2.5 s draw time | Movement speed: -5%

# Introduction

The Huntsman bow is the third bow and made during the Iron Age. Its primary attack fires arrows and charging the attack increases accuracy, damage and velocity of the arrow. It does not have a secondary attack.
It is more silent compared to other bows with attacking and hitting, only creating four meters of noise.
